theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (n : ℕ) (f : CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N) ((n : ℤ) + 2)) (F : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), HeckeEis.IsEichlerIntegral n (fun τ => f τ) F → ∀ (γ : CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (τ : UpperHalfPlane), HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.coeff e (F ((γ : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) • UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z)).val) (f τ * MvPolynomial.coeff e ((((HeckeEis.binaryFormRepSL ℂ n).comp (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N).subtype) γ) (HeckeEis.linePow n (τ : ℂ))).val) (τ : ℂ)
theorems.natural_summary: Compose the coefficientwise Eichler derivative with the modular action, whose derivative is 1/j(τ)². Slash invariance supplies j(τ)^(n+2); nonvanishing permits cancellation of j(τ)². The existing binaryFormRepSL_linePow identity identifies the remaining coefficient with that of ρ(γ)L(τ).
